resources.title: A teacher comes to you (Hospital/Homebound)
resources.description: Georgia’s Hospital/Homebound (HHB) rule lets a student who will miss at least 10 school days (or has repeated 3-day absences from a chronic condition) get instruction at home. A treating physician signs a referral form, and the student must get at least 3 hours of instruction per school week. An adult must be present for each home session if the student is under 18.
resources.good_if: you can’t sit up for long or can’t travel, and your doctor says you can still learn at home.
resources.hours: Ask your school counselor [COUNSELOR NAME] how Forsyth County Schools starts a referral.

resources.title: Georgia Virtual School (GAVS)
resources.description: Forsyth County Schools lists Georgia Virtual School as an online course option for high schoolers. You complete the FCS Online Course Application in Infinite Campus first, then create your GAVS student account on the official sign-up page and add courses (A courses in fall, B in spring). Courses are only approved after the FCS application is done.
resources.good_if: recovery may last a semester or more and you want to earn credit online at your own pace.

resources.title: Forsyth Virtual Academy (FVA)
resources.description: A virtual program run by Forsyth County Schools’ Academies of Creative Education (ACE). It offers virtual courses for middle and high school (grades 6–12), with counseling, mentoring and getting-started guides. Registration windows are set each year, so check the page or ask your school counselor.
resources.good_if: you want a school-run online option and can check dates and courses with your counselor.

resources.title: Big Creek Greenway
resources.description: Forsyth’s flagship paved trail: just over 16.5 miles from Halcyon to Sawnee Mountain Preserve for walking, running and biking, with about one mile of boardwalk near Union Hill. Trailheads: Halcyon (6265 Cortland Walk), Union Hill (5259 Union Hill Rd), Fowler Park (4110 Carolene Way), Bethelview (5120 Bethelview Rd), Sawnee Mountain Preserve (4075 Spot Rd). A section from Fowler Park north to the Bethelview Trailhead has been closed for renovation since Feb. 25, 2026, so check the county page before you go. A roughly one-mile gap along SR 20 is planned to be connected with GDOT’s Canton Highway widening.
resources.good_if: you want a long, flat, mostly shaded run you can shorten whenever you need to.
resources.address: Trailheads: Halcyon, Union Hill, Fowler Park, Bethelview, Sawnee
resources.map_query: Big Creek Greenway Fowler Park Trailhead, 4110 Carolene Way, Cumming, GA
